test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Instead of attend the class he went to watch the cricket match.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'attend the class.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part 'attend the class' is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The verb coming directly after **instead of** must be in the **-ing form.**
 
• **Structure: ****instead of + verb + -ing**.
 
 
• **Example**: *He went alone** instead of waiting **for me.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'attend the class' in the sentence should be replaced with 'attending the class' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Thus, the correct option is 'attend the class.'
 
• ​​The correct sentence__:* **Instead of **attending the class** he went to watch the cricket match.*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• We can use instead of in the following ways:
 
 
• **instead of + noun**

 
 
• **Example**: *I'll have tea **instead of **coffee.*
 
 
 
• *​***instead of + pronoun *you, us,* etc.**
 
 
• **Example:* ****I'll go instead of him.*
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• भाग 'attend the class​' गलत है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• Instead of के सामने आने वाली क्रिया -ing रूप में होनी चाहिए।
 
• Structure: instead of + verb + -ing.
 
 
• Example: *He went alone instead of waiting for me.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए वाक्य में 'attend the class' के प्रयोग को व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही बनाने के लिए 'attending the class' से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए।
